abstract: Serve many LoRA adapters over one base model with per-request adapter selection and runtime load and unload. Covers exact flags, defaults and constraints for vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM and llama.cpp, plus the documented status for TensorFold, Ollama and ExLlamaV3, with a quality gate for merges, scale blends and quantized bases and adapter isolation checks. References split into an engine flag matrix and a quality-gate procedure.
